verdict.rationale: Better Stack's AI SRE investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors and web events, suggests hypotheses, and answers natural-language questions with logs or charts. It also produces AI-based ticket suggestions, suggested-fix PRs and automated post-mortems, and is reachable through online chat as well as Slack. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs (all evidence is marketing-page claims), independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and clearer evidence that insights surface inside the product UI rather than mainly through Slack or MCP.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Slack-native AI SRE agent that investigates incidents using your logs, metrics, traces, errors, and web events.
The AI SRE suggests hypotheses but never takes any automated actions without your approval.
Get recent logs or chart visualizations by simply asking in natural language.
Chat online, inside Slack and in Claude Code using the MCP
Create Linear tickets to fix the root cause using AI-based suggestions with a single tap.
Get an automated post-mortem based on the incident timeline and Slack.
